requirement.statement: C# OM SHALL export and import versioned behavior definitions while explicitly representing callback readiness and failing closed for unresolved behavior.

case.given: The same behavior catalog is exported repeatedly
case.then: The version, normalized keys, entry order, and bytes SHALL be stable

case.given: A catalog contains every supported behavior kind
case.then: All metadata, keys, binding identifiers, and readiness facts SHALL be semantically preserved

case.given: JSON and YAML documents describe the same catalog
case.then: They SHALL produce identical catalog values, diagnostics, and effects

case.given: A manifest declares an unsupported version or behavior kind
case.then: Import SHALL fail with structured diagnostics before state changes

case.given: A manifest contains duplicate or conflicting behavior keys
case.then: The conflict SHALL be reported deterministically and no state SHALL change

case.given: Behavior metadata and callback binding identities were persisted before process restart
case.when: The same database is opened with an empty executable registry
case.then: Export SHALL preserve binding identities and SHALL project every callback slot as unresolved until rebound

case.given: An existing OM database predates the behavior binding relation
case.when: Additive schema initialization or snapshot restore runs
case.then: The binding relation SHALL be initialized without changing existing behavior definitions and SHALL participate in later snapshots

case.given: A valid manifest references callback bindings that are absent
case.when: It is imported in default mode
case.then: Metadata SHALL import as inactive/unresolved and diagnostics SHALL identify each missing binding

case.given: An imported behavior is unresolved
case.then: The runtime SHALL fail closed with owner, behavior key, and binding identifier

case.given: An unresolved behavior receives a compatible typed callback binding
case.then: Readiness SHALL atomically become ready and execution SHALL use the typed registry

case.given: At least one required callback binding is missing or incompatible
case.when: The manifest is imported with requireReady enabled
case.then: The whole import SHALL fail and metadata, registry, and readiness state SHALL remain unchanged

case.given: Preflight succeeds but persistent or registry apply fails
case.then: All prior metadata, callback registrations, and readiness facts SHALL be restored

case.given: An imported constraint has an unresolved when, then, or validator binding
case.then: Evaluation SHALL fail closed and identify the exact callback slot and binding id

case.given: An imported computed property has an unresolved compute binding
case.when: It is read directly, through an entity view, or as of a historical time
case.then: Every read path SHALL fail closed with the same binding diagnostic instead of omitting or falling back

case.given: An imported action or an ancestor action selected by parent dispatch is unresolved
case.when: The action or CallParentAction path resolves it
case.then: Dispatch SHALL fail closed before mutations and identify the selected owner and binding id

case.given: An imported nearest mutation definition is unresolved
case.when: An action executes its mutation list
case.then: Mutation resolution SHALL fail closed before invoking any missing executor

case.given: Persisted before or after interceptor definitions contain an unresolved exact owner/action/phase/seq binding
case.then: Execution SHALL fail closed rather than skip the interceptor, preserving the exact keyed diagnostic

case.given: An import is paused between persistent staging and registry publication
case.when: A concurrent behavior resolution attempts to observe readiness
case.then: It SHALL observe the complete pre-import or post-import state and never a split state

case.given: Registry publication fails after persistence and persistent compensation also fails
case.then: The error SHALL preserve the original publication failure and all compensation failures without claiming atomic restoration

case.given: Imported interceptor keys have sparse or conflicting local sequences
case.when: They are staged, published, exported, and extended
case.then: Exact keys SHALL be preserved, conflicts SHALL fail preflight, and new local sequence SHALL use max plus one

case.given: A YAML manifest exceeds configured limits or uses multiple documents, custom tags, merge keys, or unsafe aliases
case.then: It SHALL fail before canonical catalog effects and Om.Core SHALL remain free of a YAML dependency
